# Viktoriya Mikhaylova - AI Product Design Portfolio

> Viktoriya Mikhaylova designs accessible, human-centered digital products. This portfolio documents UX research, product strategy, UI/UX design, human-AI interaction, accessibility, branding, and web development.

The public case-study pages describe design decisions, prototypes, tools, and project outcomes. Concepts and planned tests are labelled as such; prototype content must not be interpreted as measured production results.

## Case Studies

- [LeaveReady](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/leaveready/): Human-centered AI commute decision support, transparent uncertainty, critical states, memory control, and UI audit.
- [HaeSiivooja](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/haesiivooja/): Live two-sided service marketplace, customer booking and cleaner workflow UX.
- [AURA Atelier](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/aura/): Conversational luxury shopping, emotional UX, curated recommendations, and AI-to-human advisor handoff.
- [CleanPeer](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/cleanpeer/): Cleaner-first problem-solving experience, information architecture, expert-backed guidance, and interactive UX prototype.
- [AccessBloom](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/accessbloom/): AI-assisted website accessibility checker, interpretation of findings, prioritization, and human oversight.
- [Laurea Digital Living Lab](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/laurea/): Responsive website, information architecture, graphic assets, photography, and web development.
- [SAKUstars 2022](https://vik.ooo/case-studies/sakustars-2022/): Visual identity, original owl illustration, WordPress site, animation, print, and merchandise.
